## Methods

### `BlurAsync()`

Removes keyboard focus from the field.
Returns: `ValueTask`.

### `Decrement()`

Decreases the value by Step (default 1), clamped to Min/Max.
Returns: `Task`.

### `DisposeAsync()`

Returns: `ValueTask`.

### `Increment()`

Increases the value by Step (default 1), clamped to Min/Max.
Returns: `Task`.

### `SelectAsync()`

Selects (highlights) all the text in the field.
Returns: `ValueTask`.
